transcript: When is it okay to comment on a musical you haven't seen, but only listen to the cast recording? I saw some discourse around this because of a video posted by a content creator I really like the Musical Dealer, and I agree with a part of the criticism, but I also think it's taking the video a little bit out of context. And of course, I realize the irony of that phrasing in this case. First thing I wanna quickly say, and hopefully we can all agree on this, is that it is valid to critique and review the cast recording itself. It's fair game and in fact worthwhile to assess how successful it is at promoting the show in conveying what it's like. And I also think it's important to get that perspective from someone who hasn't seen the show, because that tells you a lot about how the cast recording is being received by a large portion of its target audience. But I understand that's not why the video got backlash. It was because he seems to be commenting on the show itself, not just the cast recording. And yes, of course, I agree with that. As a huge fan of live theater, I obviously understand that it's very different hearing something on a cast recording than being actually in the room and seeing how it works in context. Having said that, though, I think we might be dealing with a slight case of context collapse. I've experienced this first hand as a content creator, you know, I've been dinged a couple times, for example, for reviewing a show and not mentioning that it is being performed in New York. But, you know, I make content almost exclusively about New York theatre. New York is in my bio. still, I try to mention it in the video or in the caption, but, you know, I make a lot of content. Sometimes I forget, especially when a lot of my content is viewed by the same regular, repeat viewers. But then sometimes a video can break containment when you're not expecting it to and people don't know or care what your usual content is and they assume bad faith. All that to say, even if the wording in Musical Dealer’s video could have been chosen differently, if you have the context that his entire page is dedicated to reviewing cast recordings, it's not that hard to figure out what he actually meant.
classificationReason: Meta-commentary about the ethics/validity of reviewing a musical based solely on a cast recording, without reviewing any specific listed production.
